verdict.rationale: Supabase enables AI assistants (via MCP) to query and interact with a user's Supabase data, and provides a pgvector-based AI toolkit for building AI features into apps, but there is no evidence of a first-party in-dashboard 'insights and suggestions' feature that surfaces AI-generated analysis directly inside Supabase Studio. The MCP-based approach requires connecting an external AI assistant rather than the product itself generating insights natively. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in Studio AI insights/suggestions feature, evidence of automatic proactive suggestions (vs. user-initiated querying via external assistant), independent hands-on validation of insight quality.
